subject: POC ops rampsheet: org setup, API keys, IP allowlist & VPC peering timeline
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@novamed.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@novamed.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — environment needs & sequencing

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for the kickoff yesterday — we sketched out a rough MAP in the meeting but want to lock down the operational steps so engineering can start tomorrow. High level ask from our infra team:

- Single org for the POC with two API keys (ingest + eval)
- Static IPs to put on our allowlist (for webhook/ingress)
- VPC peering from our dev VPC to Redwood's POC VPC (we'll provide CIDR/ASN)
- Test window between Apr 12–16 where we run a 24hr smoke test

Can you send a compact rampsheet with owners, expected lead times, and any templates we need to fill (peering OR a request for KMS access if required)? If possible we need a go/no-go by Apr 8 to keep the close timeline.

Appreciate it —
Alex
Principal Platform Eng, NovaMed

--
Attachment: none
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@novamed.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — environment needs & sequencing

Alex / Priya —

Thanks — I put together a condensed rampsheet (attached) that maps each POC item to an owner and an expected SLA. Short version: we can deliver org + API keys within 48 business hours after your PO/POC agreement; static IPs require a dedicated /28 allocation from our infra team and take 2–3 business days; VPC peering is straightforward but needs the peering template and a short route table change on your side (1–2 business days once we have CIDR + ASN).

Key next steps (suggested):
1) We send the peering template and your network team fills CIDR/ASN — target Apr 5
2) You confirm whether you want keys rotated daily for the smoke test — target Apr 6
3) Redwood creates POC org and two API keys (ingest/eval) — target Apr 7
4) VPC peering completes and smoke test window is scheduled Apr 12–16

I'll loop Connor for the static IPs and Karthik for any project-level IAM/KMS decisions. Attaching the rampsheet + peering template.

Evelyn Hart
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai | M: (415) 555-0198

- redwood-poc-rampsheet.pdf (owners + SLA table)

From: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@novamed.com>

Cc: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@novamed.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — environment needs & sequencing

Evelyn —

Thanks for the rampsheet. Quick clarifications from our network team:
- We'll provide CIDR + ASN by EOD Apr 6 (working with security)
- For IP allowlist, do you provide a single static egress IP or a small range? They asked for exact size (/32 vs /28).
- For KMS: we need to know whether Redwood will hold keys (managed) or if we supply a customer-managed key (CMK). If CMK is required for this POC that's a blocker for Apr 12–16.

Also — for the API keys: can the ingest key be rate-limited to 1000 req/min? Our early load tests will hit the endpoint and we want to avoid accidental throttling on your side.

Priya
Lead SRE, NovaMed
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@novamed.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@novamed.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 16:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC ops rampsheet: org setup, API keys, IP allowlist & VPC peering timeline

Priya / Alex —

Quick consolidated update after checking with infra and product ops:
- CIDR/ASN: great, once you send them we will populate the peering doc and initiate the peering (owner: Connor)
- Static IPs: Redwood will allocate a /29 range for the POC egress; I'll confirm the exact four IPs by Mon Apr 11 (owner: Vanessa)
- API keys: we will create two keys under a single POC org (ingest/eval). Ingest will be preconfigured with a soft limit of 2,000 req/min and token bucket smoothing; we can adjust to 1,000 req/min if you prefer. Keys will be posted to your Vault URL (or we can push to your designated S3).
- KMS: for the smoke test we will use Redwood-managed keys. If you require a CMK we need that decision by Apr 11 to avoid blocking the Apr 12 test window (owner: Karthik).

Action items and owners:
- Alex: confirm Vault URL or S3 for key delivery (by Apr 11)
- Priya: send CIDR + ASN (by Apr 6 — noted)
- Connor O'Brien (Redwood infra): initiate peering once we have CIDR/ASN, target complete Apr 9
- Vanessa Ortiz (Redwood ops): publish static IPs and update allowlist doc Apr 11
- Karthik Iyer (Redwood sec): confirm CMK path or managed keys Apr 11

I'll update the HubSpot deal with these milestones and attach the finalized rampsheet. If everything lines up we are green for your Apr 12 smoke test.

Evelyn Hart
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
